name: torture-contract
description: CORRECTIVE RE-SPAWN. `emit` returns malformed JSON on its first invocation against a Finding[] contract; SPEC §9.3 allows exactly one output-only corrective re-spawn, which must carry the original prompt AND the validation error. Expected: exit 0, emit x2, second invocation carrying the corrective block (asserted by the agent). Every scripted node sets retry.max 0: the harness default (2 tries, 60s backoff) is sized for transient provider 429/529s, and a scripted agent has no provider — its failures are deterministic, so retrying is pure latency. Found by a mutation test that took four minutes to fail.

spec.task:
Emit findings.

SCENARIO: bad-json:1
EXPECT_RESPAWN: corrective

cmd: print('torture flow reached its final node')
